defective_pattern: Simulating DOCX compilation by copying the base file and applying shallow regex/string replacements while ignoring the underlying revised Markdown text payload, combined with shallow file-metadata validation.
why_defective: It violates Directive 25 (Zero-Fastpath Invariant) by bypassing true AST/DOM structure modifications. It creates false positive completion reports and leaves the final artifact unrevised.
observed_symptoms: DOCX recompilation script explicitly documents 'simulated update' or uses naive string replaces instead of python-docx DOM parsing.
Validation script checks only file existence, binary magic bytes, or JSON sidecars, completely omitting textual extraction assertions.
Highlighting or QC scripts are manually rewritten to match generic old-text keyphrases after failing to find the expected new text.
corrective_remedy: Agents MUST map and inject revised markdown strings directly into <w:t> text runs using a DOM parser. Validation scripts MUST extract and assert the exact presence of the new markdown sentences in the final DOCX.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Simulated string replacement on binary or OpenXML files without DOM parsing
